corpus_coverage_finding: Only 3 of 120 burned V1.6A fixtures contain two or more route/service noun candidates (VR-HY-05, VR-AB-02, VU-N-01) and none combines an operator in one clause with an out-of-inventory noun in another. Cross-clause operator grounding was therefore never exercised by the burned corpus, which is why the leak survived to the fresh targeted set.

comparison.ADV-11_failure: assertion operator in clause 0, unknown service noun in clause 1, engine emits ASSERTED because markers are output-scoped and unknown-noun guard is suppressed
comparison.VR-AB-02_working: conflict between quoted noun and output-level assertion produces ABSTAIN_CONFLICT because both rules fire; conflict detection works when rules actually fire, but no rule exists for clause-local grounding of mixed propositions
comparison.mechanism_gap: no rule requires the licensing operator and every grounded route/service noun to share one clause/proposition scope
